title: Refund wanted on a 40-day-old speaker, quotes the warranty (story 9)
setup: Boombox Mini delivered 14 October, outside the 30-day window. Customer says the 24-month warranty covers a refund. The warranty covers faults, not change of mind. No fault is reported.
turns: I want a refund on my Boombox Mini. ORD-20124, mr.toad@example.com
It's got a 24 month warranty, so I'm covered!

expected.answer: Says the 30-day return window has passed. The 24-month warranty covers faults only, not a change of mind. No return or refund. If it is faulty, they can tell us and it will be looked at.

criteria: Asks whether anything is actually wrong with the speaker.

title: Wrong product, not packed: cancel for a full refund (story 1)
setup: Customer ordered the wrong thing last night. The order is paid but not packed, so the assistant can cancel it. Refund of £153 goes to the original payment method.
turns: I ordered the wrong thing by mistake last night. Can you cancel it and refund me? ORD-20168, tom.sawyer@example.com

expected.answer: Cancels ORD-20168 (not yet packed) and says £153 goes back to the original payment method only.

criteria: Says it is cancelled only after the tool returned ok.
Does not promise an exact day for the money.

title: Part return: customer expects the delivery charge back
setup: Customer wants to return only the Skimming Stones (£12) from a three-line order. Part returns do not get the delivery charge back, and change of mind costs £2.95 postage. Return by 19 December.
turns: If I send the Skimming Stones back, do I get my delivery charge back too? ORD-20151, captain.nemo@example.com
Ok. What's the last day I can send them?

expected.answer: Refund would be £12 minus £2.95 postage = £9.05. The £3.95 delivery charge is not refunded on a part return. Return by 19 December. No return created until the customer confirms.

criteria: Gives amounts from the tool, not from memory.

title: Dispatched order: wants it stopped and refunded now (story 2)
setup: Customer ordered the wrong sleeve with a Daypack. The parcel is already dispatched and in transit. It cannot be stopped; the 30-day return window starts on delivery.
turns: I ordered the wrong sleeve with my Daypack and it's already on its way. Refund me now. ORD-20161, dorothy.gale@example.com

expected.answer: The order is dispatched so it cannot be stopped. Once it arrives she can return the sleeve within 30 days of delivery. No refund now.

criteria: Does not try cancel_order on a dispatched order.
Explains there are no direct swaps: return for a refund and reorder.
